sn47.6:1.1: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave sakuṇagghi lāpam sakuṇam sahasā ajjhapattā aggahesi || || 4.
sn47.6:1.2: Atha kho bhikkhave lāpo sakuṇo sakuṇagghiyā hariyamāno evam paridevasi ||
sn47.6:1.3: Mayam evamha alakkhikā mayam appapuññā ye mayam agocare carimha paravisaye ||
sn47.6:1.4: sacejja mayaṃ gocare careyyāma sake pettike visaye || na myāyam sakuṇagghi alambhavissa yad idaṃ yuddhāyā ti || ||
sn47.6:1.5: Ko pana te lāpa gocaro sako pettiko visayo ti || ||
sn47.6:1.7: Atha kho bhikkhave sakuṇagghi sake bale apatthaddhā sake bale asaṃvadamānā lāpam sakuṇaṃ pamuñci || ||
sn47.6:1.8: Gaccha kho tvaṃ lāpa tatra pi me gantvā na mokkhasī ti || || 6.
sn47.6:2.1: Atha kho bhikkhave lāpo sakuṇo naṅgalakaṭṭhakaraṇam leḍḍuṭṭhānaṃ gantvā mahantaṃ leḍḍum abhirūhitvā sakuṇagghim vadamāno aṭṭhāsi || ||
sn47.6:2.2: Ehi kho dāni me sakuṇagghi || Ehi kho dāni me sakuṇagghī ti || || 7.
sn47.6:2.3: Atha kho bhikkhave sakunagghi sake bale apatthaddhā sake bale asaṃvadamānā ubho pakkhe sannāyha lāpaṃ sakuṇaṃ sahasā ajjhapattā || ||
sn47.6:2.4: Yadā kho bhikkhave aññāsi lāpo sakuṇo Bahuṃ āgatā kho myāyam sakunagghīti || atha tasseva leḍḍussa antaram paccupādi || ||
sn47.6:2.5: Atha kho bhikkhave sakuṇagghi tattheva uram paccatālesi || || 8.
sn47.6:2.6: Evaṃ hi tam bhikkhave hoti yo agocare carati paravisaye || ||
sn47.6:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave mā agocare carittha paravisaye ||
sn47.6:3.2: agocare bhikkhave caratam paravisaye lacchati Māro otāraṃ lacchati Māro ārammaṇaṃ || || 9.
sn47.6:3.3: Ko ca bhikkhave bhikkhuno agocaro paravisayo ||
sn47.6:3.6: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn47.6:3.10: Kāyaviññeyyā poṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn47.6:4.1: Gocare bhikkhave caratha sake pettike visaye ||
sn47.6:4.2: Gocare bhikkhave carataṃ sake pettike visaye na lacchati Māro otāram na lacchati Māro ārammanaṃ || || 12.
sn47.6:4.3: Ko ca bhikkhave bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo ||
sn47.6:4.7: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyanupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn47.6:4.10: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn47.6:4.11: Ayam bhikkhave bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo
